findings.title: Both stability waits can pass a negative sleep duration
findings.evidence: Both current collectors reproduced -0.000150s in an advancing-clock/early-wakeup scenario; each failed after one source round. Native10-13 stack independently pins the daily implementation.
findings.required: Single remaining-time sample after guard; break when<=0; positive sleeps only. Add advancing clock, early wakeup, deadline crossing, cancel and total-budget negatives for both collectors.

findings.title: Fixing collection alone cannot resume the old failed Raw through the approved controller
findings.evidence: Current scope accepts launch_recovery only for Silver. Raw failure remains terminal; creating a child without migrating the controller creates duplicate_native_runs. Current disk_budget independently returns raw_activity_proof because the collecting receipt has no elapsed_ms.
findings.required: Implement the already proposed explicit single Raw recovery across all consumers; preserve old journals and failed candidate; count both old and new disk; charge failed Raw conservatively300s; use a separate durable action budget; inherit original Raw identity; transition recovered Raw to ordinary Silver, never directly complete. Keep unknown failures rejected.

findings.title: Existing completed units disappear from reported progress when a later unit failed
findings.evidence: Isolated native boundary with one literal completed unit and one failed unit returns completed0/remaining2 instead of1/1. inspect raises native_run_failed and suppresses unit facts. No POST is sent.
findings.required: Count immutable ready facts before failure decisions; report all unit states and a failure exit status without allowing writes. Separate effective successes from preserved failures. Keep subsequent submission blocked.

findings.title: Socket inactivity timeout is not a whole-request or whole-run deadline
findings.evidence: Installed Tushare1.4.29 uses Requests2.34.2 timeout=30. Loopback SDK probe with timeout0.1s succeeds after0.277s when chunks arrive every0.04s. Current300s guard runs before/after blocking calls; current job has no max-runtime tag and formal monitoring config has no explicit max-runtime.
findings.required: Complete a moneyflow-scoped total-deadline/cancellation design before coding. It must stop an in-flight slow call, release request/worker resources, preserve candidate/journal facts, and be tested with a real loopback slow response. A Future timeout that leaves the request running, a larger timeout, or a global resource/config change is not an acceptable substitute. Transport choice and process/connection/RSS cost are not yet approved or implemented.

findings.title: Previous loaded-service proof is stale even though dependencies are unchanged
findings.required: After fixes, audit current code/load and refresh isolated definitions and runtime binding; generate same-root remaining4-date children from the full47 parent. Do not reload merely because the server ID changed; reload fixed production modules only when needed and authorized. After midnight use a newly dated child without broadening dates or resetting persisted budgets.

findings.title: Final audit and repeat currently understand only the older Silver recovery
findings.evidence: Existing readback helper special-cases launch_recovery/Silver; other same-date duplicate runs and planned-only check rows are rejected. Once Raw recovery succeeds its parent must also remain visible.
findings.required: Use the same approved recovery identities in inspect, aggregate counts and zero-write repeat:98 successful jobs+2 retained failed jobs=100 runs for all49;98 physical files/materializations/evaluated passed checks;2 distinct planned-only checks do not count as failures or passes. Archive readback logic/commands in the existing maintained tool rather than relying solely on ephemeral /private/tmp scripts. Migrate all consumers together.

verified_protections.result: All90 physical hashes/rows and ready identities rechecked; unchanged; no new source calls.

37 selected existing tests passed, covering real public5572-row fixture, exact page termination, duplicate/changed source rejection, bounded retry/cancel, file hash binding, per-file intent/replace recovery and controller journals.
Independent fake native probe confirms one POST/one native run across recovery and repeat.

remaining_limits.limit: No real Tushare requests were made in this audit; Oct14-16 future source schemas/rows/two-round equality cannot be guaranteed before formal fetch. Real inconsistency or count drop must still stop, not be swallowed.

Current20-minute/120-read observation budget includes queue wait and is persisted. Controller exit does not cancel native work. Reconnect to the same native identity; do not reset quotas or resubmit because of waiting.

remaining_limits.area: Publication helper vs native run recovery
remaining_limits.limit: Existing interrupted-publication tests reuse operation_id=resume in isolated helpers. They do not prove that a failed Dagster run with a new run ID can reuse the original operation. A file published without native delivery remains a separate explicit repair scope; no generic automatic recovery claim.

Historical Silver recovery checks os.kill(pid,0) on a numeric PID even after a successful child. A future PID reuse could cause a false stop; current audit passed this check. Avoid a broad new process-management feature; pin a final-readback regression so an unrelated reused PID cannot invalidate an already verified delivery.

verification.codegraph_scope: collectors/request session/raw writer/publication/assets; CLI/plan/Journal/state/execution/recovery; no Ops/Web/qtf changes

decision: Do not proceed by fixing sleep only. Complete one coherent repair design and implementation, then exercise the exact failure-to-Raw-to-Silver-to-next3-to-final49-to-zero-write-repeat path with isolated resources before formal resumption.
